For $P(x)$ to be a permutation polynomial modulo $2013 = 3 \times 11 \times 61$, it must be a permutation polynomial modulo 3, 11, and 61. The number of such pairs $(a_3, a_1)$ modulo each prime is 6, 20, and 60, respectively. By CRT, the total number of pairs $(a_3, a_1) \pmod{2013}$ is $6 \times 20 \times 60 = 7200$.
